title: In from the Rain  (雨の中から)

segments.t: 物静かな建築家のケイレブが、夜の雨にコートをぐっしょり濡らしてフロントに入ってきました。テッサが乾いたタオルと温かいスープを差し出し、ハンナは予約の手違いを正直に打ち明けようとします。英語の響きに耳を傾けながら、場面全体を聴いてみましょう。
Good evening! Come inside out of the rain, sir.
Good evening. Sorry for dripping water on your clean floor.
Do not worry at all! You must be Caleb.
Yes, Caleb. I booked room seven by phone yesterday.
Here is a dry towel for your coat and a cup of hot soup, sir.
Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.
Sir, before we go upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.
Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?
We accidentally booked two guests into room seven tonight.
Ah... in this rain? Every hotel near the station looked full.
Please do not worry! We prepared our quiet third floor attic study just for you.
An attic study? May I see it first?
それでは、雨の夜のフロントでの会話を、一行ずつ見ていきましょう。
Good evening! Come inside out of the rain, sir.
'こんばんは！雨に濡れますから、どうぞ中へお入りください。'
Good evening. Sorry for dripping water on your clean floor.
'こんばんは。きれいな床に水を垂らしてしまってすみません。'
Do not worry at all! You must be Caleb.
'どうぞお気になさらず！ケイレブ様ですね。'
Yes, Caleb. I booked room seven by phone yesterday.
'はい、ケイレブです。昨日、電話で七号室を予約しました。'
Here is a dry towel for your coat and a cup of hot soup, sir.
'コート用の乾いたタオルと、温かいスープをどうぞ。'
Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.
'温かいスープですか？あの冷たい雨の中を歩いた後だと、本当にありがたいです。'
Sir, before we go upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.
'お客様、上の階へご案内する前に、正直にお詫びしなければならないことがあります。'
Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?
'おや？私の予約に何か問題でも？'
We accidentally booked two guests into room seven tonight.
'手違いで、今夜の七号室に二人のお客さんを予約してしまったのです。'
Ah... in this rain? Every hotel near the station looked full.
'ああ…この雨の中で？駅の近くのホテルはどこも満室のようでしたが。'
Please do not worry! We prepared our quiet third floor attic study just for you.
'どうかご心配なく！静かな三階の屋根裏の書斎を、お客様のためだけにご用意しました。'
An attic study? May I see it first?
'屋根裏の書斎ですか？先に見せていただけますか？'
今度は、出迎えの場面全体を自然な速さで通して聴いてみましょう。
Good evening! Come inside out of the rain, sir.
Good evening. Sorry for dripping water on your clean floor.
Do not worry at all! You must be Caleb.
Yes, Caleb. I booked room seven by phone yesterday.
Here is a dry towel for your coat and a cup of hot soup, sir.
Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.
Sir, before we go upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.
Oh? Is there a problem with my booking?
We accidentally booked two guests into room seven tonight.
Ah... in this rain? Every hotel near the station looked full.
Please do not worry! We prepared our quiet third floor attic study just for you.
An attic study? May I see it first?
ハンナの誠実な説明に、ケイレブはまず屋根裏部屋を見てみたいと答えました。次の場面では、三人で屋根裏へ上がり、ケイレブの反応を見届けます。
See you soon!
